ei.title: The belief that vision is important...
ei.subject: 5월_2026 고3 모의고사
ei.lesson: The belief that vision is important...

fullPassage:
The belief that vision is important to driving safely is the reason why measurements of visual capability are an integral part of the test for issuing a driving licence in most countries.

(A) The fact is the drivers' task is a complex one, involving both visual and cognitive factors. Within a very limited time, the driver has to interpret what is likely to happen on the road ahead.

(B) Despite these requirements, attempts to find a link between simple visual functions such as visual sharpness and the accident record of drivers have proved largely fruitless. This may be because drivers with worse visual capabilities are aware of their abilities and drive within limits. Alternatively, it may be that the visual capabilities measured are too simple.

(C) To do this, the driver has developed a series of expectations of other drivers' behaviour and of what are the appropriate locations to examine. The driver will be faced with objects of different degrees of visibility and noticeability and will have to make judgements for which the visual system is not always well suited.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② involved → involving: 과업이 요인을 '포함하는' 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 involving이 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① safely — driving safely: 부사가 동명사 수식 정상
✅ ② involved — 원문은 involving. a complex one, involving both visual and cognitive factors: 주어(task)가 요인을 '포함하는' 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 involving이 정상. involved는 수동 ←정답
❌ ③ measured — the visual capabilities measured: 과거분사가 명사 뒤에서 수동 수식 정상
❌ ④ suited — the visual system is not always well suited: be suited (적합하다) 수동 정상
det.tip: involving: 능동(~을 포함하는) / involved: 수동(~에 관련된). 여기서 task가 factors를 포함하므로 involving.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ that → what: interpret의 목적어로 선행사 포함 관계대명사 what이 필요
det.analysis:
❌ ① why — the reason why measurements of visual capability are: 관계부사 why 정상
❌ ② to interpret — the driver has to interpret: have to + 동사원형 정상
✅ ③ that — 원문은 what. interpret what is likely to happen: what은 선행사 포함 관계대명사로 '일어날 가능성이 있는 것'의 의미. that으로 바꾸면 선행사 없이 불완전 ←정답
❌ ④ largely — have proved largely fruitless: 부사가 형용사 수식 정상
det.tip: what is likely to happen: what = 선행사 포함 관계대명사(the thing which). that은 선행사 필요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① is likely to → is likely: to가 중복되어 is likely가 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① is likely to — 원문은 is likely. interpret what is likely to happen: 'likely to happen'에서 to happen이 필수. 'is likely to'로 바꾸면 to가 중복(to happen이 이미 뒤에 있으므로 to to happen이 됨) ←정답
❌ ② have proved — attempts have proved largely fruitless: 현재완료 정상
❌ ③ are aware — drivers are aware of their abilities: be aware of 정상
❌ ④ has developed — the driver has developed: 현재완료 단수 주어 정상
det.tip: what is likely to happen: is likely 뒤에 to happen이 연결. 'is likely to'로 쓰면 to가 이중으로 나타남.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

✅ ④ which — 원문은 for which. judgements for which the visual system is not always well suited: suited는 전치사 for와 함께 쓰임(be suited for). for which가 정상. which만 쓰면 전치사 누락 ←정답
det.tip: be suited for ~: ~에 적합하다. 관계대명사 앞에 전치사 for 필수 → for which.
